test_title: PYST 24: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 3 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence contains a grammatical error. Select the option that correctly rectifies the error.

As a rule, single sentences should not be write or printed as paragraphs.

options.text: As a rule, single sentences should not be wrote or printed as paragraphs.
As a rule, single sentences should not write or print as paragraphs.
As a rule, single sentences shall not have written or printed as paragraphs.
As a rule, single sentences should not be written or printed as paragraphs.

solution:
The correct answer is **"As a rule, single sentences should not be written or printed as paragraphs."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Should** is a **phrasal verb** that denotes if something is right or best to do, or whether someone must or ought to do something.
 
• According to the **English grammar**, the past participle form of the verb must be used after **"should be"**.
 
• The past participle form of **"write"** is **"written"**.

So the correct sentence will be **As a rule, single sentences should not be written__ or printed as paragraphs.**
